reason: My site is stuck in 2019 and I know it, but I am not handing 1,200 EUR up front plus a 12-month contract to someone who does this 10 hours a week after his day job and whose 'launch price for the first two clients' tells me nobody has gone through this yet. I have been through an agency vanishing once; I ask who answers the phone in a year, and here the honest answer is 'maybe'.
objection: A part-time founder with no finished reference clients, asking me to lock in for twelve months at 140 EUR a month for automations I am not sure my 5-15 clients a year even justify; most of my work comes by phone and recommendation, not through a web form.
would_change_my_mind: Two named consultants in Romania I can call who have been live on his sites for at least six months, plus a month-to-month subscription instead of a 12-month lock-in, and I would seriously look at the START package to replace my old site.
